title: chore(ci): bump supabase/setup-cli to v2, suppress intentional console warning
body:
## Why
Latest CI run had two warning annotations: a GitHub Actions Node 20 deprecation notice on `supabase/setup-cli@v1`, and an ESLint `no-console` warning on an intentional diagnostic log in a test helper.

## What
- Bump `supabase/setup-cli@v1` → `@v2` at both call sites in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`ci` and `deploy` jobs). v2 is a Bun-based composite action with no Node runtime declaration, so it can't trigger the deprecation warning. Confirmed the `version: latest` input is unchanged in meaning between v1 and v2.
- Add `// eslint-disable-next-line no-console -- ...` above the intentional `console.warn` in `tests/helpers/auth.ts`'s `cleanupUser()`, matching the existing suppression convention already used in `src/pages/api/cron/purge.ts`.

## How to verify
- CI on this PR should pass with no Node 20 deprecation annotation and no `no-console` annotation on `tests/helpers/auth.ts:57`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, and the migration dry-run step should all still pass unchanged.

## Risk & rollback
No application behavior change — CI tooling version bump and a lint suppression comment only. Revert by reverting this commit if `supabase/setup-cli@v2` misbehaves in the runner.

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
